intent: Replace GTA-mention YoY with generic Bluesky day-off posts YoY

edits.new_content:
version: 2

metrics:
  - name: day_off_index
    label: Day-Off Index
    description: Geometric mean of the Thursday lifts of the day-off intent signals (Google Trends, Bluesky, Reddit), x 100. 100 is a normal week. Group by index_year__study_year.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: day_off_index_measure

  - name: day_off_index_2026
    label: Day-Off Index, GTA week (2026)
    description: The Day-Off Index for release Thursday 19 Nov 2026 against Thursday 12 Nov 2026.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: day_off_index_measure
    filter: |
      {{ Dimension('index_year__study_year') }} = 2026

  - name: day_off_index_2025
    label: Day-Off Index, control week (2025)
    description: The same index for Thu 20 Nov 2025 against Thu 13 Nov 2025, before GTA 6. The seasonal baseline.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: day_off_index_measure
    filter: |
      {{ Dimension('index_year__study_year') }} = 2025

  - name: day_off_index_gta_effect
    label: Day-Off Index, net of season
    description: The 2026 index divided by the 2025 control index, x 100. What is left after the pre-Thanksgiving drift. 100 = GTA 6 changed nothing.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: 100 * day_off_index_2026 / nullif(day_off_index_2025, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: day_off_index_2026
        - name: day_off_index_2025

  - name: thursday_lift
    label: Thursday lift
    description: Release Thursday's value over the Thursday before, per signal. 1.0 = a normal week. Group by thursday_lift__source, __signal, __geo and __study_year.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: lift

  - name: signal_value
    label: Signal value
    description: Daily value of a signal. Always group by signal_day__source, signal_day__signal and signal_day__geo; never add across signals.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: signal_value_measure

  - name: signal_value_prior_week_ratio
    label: Signal, week over week
    description: A signal's value over its value seven days earlier. On a Thursday this is the Thursday lift.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: signal_value / nullif(signal_value_prior_week, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: signal_value
        - name: signal_value
          offset_window: 1 week
          alias: signal_value_prior_week

  - name: day_off_mentions
    label: Day-off mentions
    description: Posts saying someone is taking time off (any reason), summed over seed phrases. Group by signal_day__source.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: signal_value_measure
    filter: |
      {{ Dimension('signal_day__signal') }} = 'posts:day_off'

  - name: day_off_mentions_gta
    label: Day-off mentions that say GTA
    description: Posts saying someone is taking time off that also mention GTA.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: signal_value_measure
    filter: |
      {{ Dimension('signal_day__signal') }} = 'posts:day_off_gta'

  - name: gta_share_of_day_off_talk
    label: GTA share of day-off talk
    description: Day-off posts that mention GTA, as a share of all day-off posts. A fraction (0 to 1). Thursday-is-chattier effects cancel out.
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: day_off_mentions_gta
      denominator: day_off_mentions

  - name: gta_wiki_pageviews
    label: GTA VI Wikipedia pageviews
    description: Daily user pageviews of the English Wikipedia article Grand Theft Auto VI. The hype line.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: signal_value_measure
    filter: |
      {{ Dimension('signal_day__signal') }} = 'pageviews:grand_theft_auto_vi'

  - name: search_interest
    label: Search interest
    description: Google Trends relative interest (0-100 within one request). Group by signal_day__signal and signal_day__geo.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: signal_value_measure
    filter: |
      {{ Dimension('signal_day__source') }} = 'google_trends'

  - name: bluesky_day_off_posts_2026
    label: Bluesky day-off posts, 2026
    description: Bluesky posts per UTC day saying someone is taking a day off, PTO or calling in sick (any reason), 2026 study window. Release is Thu 19 Nov 2026 (days_from_release 0).
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: signal_value_measure
    filter: |
      {{ Dimension('signal_day__signal') }} = 'posts:day_off' and {{ Dimension('signal_day__source') }} = 'bluesky' and {{ Dimension('signal_day__study_year') }} = 2026

  - name: bluesky_day_off_posts_2025
    label: Bluesky day-off posts, 2025
    description: The same count in the 2025 control window, aligned on Thu 20 Nov 2025 (days_from_release 0), the same weekday a year earlier.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: signal_value_measure
    filter: |
      {{ Dimension('signal_day__signal') }} = 'posts:day_off' and {{ Dimension('signal_day__source') }} = 'bluesky' and {{ Dimension('signal_day__study_year') }} = 2025

  - name: bluesky_day_off_posts_yoy
    label: Bluesky day-off posts, year over year
    description: Bluesky day-off posts (any reason) in 2026 over the same weekday-aligned days of 2025 (x times; 1.0 = no change). The headline is release day, signal_day__days_from_release = 0 (Thu 19 Nov 2026 vs Thu 20 Nov 2025). Always filter days_from_release to days both years have loaded. Posts, not headcount; association, not causation; includes Bluesky's own platform growth.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: bluesky_day_off_posts_2026 / nullif(bluesky_day_off_posts_2025, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: bluesky_day_off_posts_2026
        - name: bluesky_day_off_posts_2025
